title: Loader-verification nine-document reference set anchors mid-June default shipment across five frameworks
body: By mid-June 2026 the agentic-AI loader-verification reference set settles as a nine-document academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring-plus-workshop-consolidation-plus-workshop-extension bundle that the LangChain plus AutoGen plus CrewAI plus Haystack plus Pydantic AI maintainer cohort ships as the default verification surface bundle from Friday's RC1 branch cuts, with the framework default-shipment commitment now treating the bundle as a stable closing pre-Memorial-Day snapshot rather than an open verification surface. The Sunday weekend closes the closing pre-Memorial-Day research cycle with the workshop-extension companion in place atop a doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop. A Sunday arxiv release (2605.08312) extends the now-canonical four-paper applied-deployment-plus-operator-side-compliance-plus-workshop-consolidation reference set with a second workshop-style measurement-and-verification overlay that applies the consolidation survey plus the applied-deployment evaluation companion plus the operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion plus Saturday's workshop-consolidation companion to the federal-civilian directive's second full weekend operating window under compliance-monitoring mode, reporting the eleven-operator sample's per-operator attestation-event arithmetic holding inside the consolidation survey's predicted bounds for a fifth consecutive cross-section sample. A Sunday Simon Willison weekend reading characterizes the paper as the canonical closing pre-Memorial-Day end-of-cycle settling artifact for the loader-verification line and observes that the timing — released into the second weekend operating day of the compliance-monitoring phase against a doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight FMRB classified-annex backdrop — completes a nine-document reference set the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle can cite as a single coherent academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring-plus-workshop-consolidation-plus-workshop-extension end-to-end reference heading into the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption. A Sunday Hugging Face Blog weekend post reports the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort holding Friday's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle RC1 branch cut on each project's main cleanly through both weekend days without further churn, with the cohort treating the RC1 cut plus the now-doubly-weekend-aged nine-document reference set as the canonical closing pre-Memorial-Day stable snapshot the upcoming release-cycle execution week will resume against. A Sunday andrew.ooo weekend reading observes the workshop-extension companion extends the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index by a second workshop-style measurement-and-verification overlay covering the eleven-operator sample across both weekend operating days, giving the framework cohort a directly citable doubly-weekend-aged end-to-end measurement-and-verification artifact alongside the prior four deployment-line papers. The structural force is that once a second workshop-style measurement-and-verification overlay joins the eight-document cluster on the second weekend operating day under compliance-monitoring mode against a doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, the maintainer cohort holds its Friday RC1 branch cuts cleanly through both weekend days without churn, the consolidated reference-implementation index extends to cover the second workshop-overlay, the vLLM v0.11.4 stable build holds its sixth full operating day with no escalations, and the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix conformance suite holds green for a seventh consecutive day on the eight-document end-to-end conformance run, the nine-document reference set's promotion from RC-runway to settled default-shipment anchor compresses to post-Memorial-Day release-engineering arithmetic rather than an unresolved verification question. The most likely landing is the nine-document reference set — the four-paper academic cluster plus arxiv 2605.07891 consolidation survey plus arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion plus arxiv 2605.08147 operator-side compliance-monitoring companion plus arxiv 2605.08234 workshop-consolidation companion plus arxiv 2605.08312 workshop-extension companion — shipping as the default verification surface bundle inside the mid-June default-shipment window, with each of the five framework projects tagging stable from their Friday RC1 branches inside the mid-June release window, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix shipping general availability the same first week of June with default support, and the cleared CISA compliance-monitoring phase plus the cleared FMRB executive instrument cited together as the doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop. Bear case is that one of the five RC1 branches logs a schema-drift regression during the post-Memorial-Day dry-run week and the default-shipment slips one minor release cycle into late June; absent that, mid-June 2026 lands the nine-document reference set as the framework default-shipment anchor.

summary: Sunday arxiv 2605.08312 adds a second workshop-style measurement-and-verification overlay to the eight-document loader-verification cluster on the second weekend operating day under compliance-monitoring mode, with the maintainer cohort holding Friday's RC1 branch cuts cleanly through both weekend days. By mid-June 2026 the nine-document reference set ships as the framework default-shipment anchor.
